title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of NbTaTiV refractory high-entropy alloy
process_description: prepared by ball milling high purity (>99.5 wt%) Nb, Ta, Ti and V powders in equiatomic composition for 12 hours in argon atmosphere with ball-to-powder mass ratio of 10:1 and milling speed of 250 rpm, followed by spark plasma sintering at 1700°C for 30 minutes under 30 MPa pressure
